repairs.general_rule: Treat lower/lowered/lowering error or defect rates as direct outcome reductions, not sentence-specific templates.
Continuation forms such as proceed with it, keep doing that, and 그 작업을 이어가 defer their anaphor to typed pragmatic task memory instead of entity or conditional-subject resolution.
A fully bound continuation gate with no reference ambiguity grounds the turn and suppresses immediate candidate competition without authorizing CONTINUE.
English outcome joins result and output as a typed local/cross-turn result noun while retaining quote boundaries.
Terminal punctuation inside a closed reported quotation can separate a following independent directive; note/reads and Korean memo/report cues remain non-authoritative report frames.
